gameplay_rules.clickability: Every one of the 1,536 cells on each SVG is an interactive SVG button. Clicking selects/highlights it and dispatches keep-cell-select.
gameplay_rules.movement: Movement pathfinding uses only cells with walkable=true and door/passage state. Each orthogonal cell costs 5 feet; diagonal movement is disabled by default.
gameplay_rules.floor_changes: Normal stairs and discovered secret passages create cross-floor graph edges. Passage use ends exploration movement unless an ability overrides it.
gameplay_rules.cooperative_start: All active tokens begin in unique cells in the first-floor Foyer.
gameplay_rules.pvp_start: Tokens are distributed throughout the keep and may begin on any of the four floors.
gameplay_rules.hidden_information: Secret passages, traps, monsters, and hidden containers are server-private until discovered. SVG art does not reveal them.
gameplay_rules.public_location_cards: Public room gameplay cards do not expose encounter placement or concealed map-state data.

source_provenance.integration: Former source zips were extracted, updated for four floors, and organized into css/json/docs. No nested zip archives remain.

full_pvp.spawn_safety: Approved starts may not occupy a door, stair, secret-passage entrance, trap, chest, crate, loose-item, or monster cell. The Armory is never a starting room because immediate weapon access is too strong.
full_pvp.randomization: The listed eight-room assignment is the canonical fixed seed. A host may rotate character-to-room assignments only among these eight approved spawn cells.
full_pvp.placement_note: Arena-style starts use eight separated rooms across all four floors. The corrected Alchemist’s Quarters spawn is inside the bedchamber; no character starts in the Armory.
